rationale: Ahmad brings deep expertise in AI-native hardware form factors—from Vision Pro at Apple to hand-tracking at Leap Motion—while Lisa is building at the intersection of XR, AI, and robotics. Their intersection on computer vision and next-gen spatial interfaces could spark ideas around how robotics and XR hardware can leverage generative AI more deeply than bolt-on approaches.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Lisa Wang — you're both working on hardware that merges XR and AI, and Ahmad's conviction on AI-native form factors (not pendants or simple wearables) could directly inform what Redbey Lakes is building.
